A checkout that was paid in the meantime stays paid. --- ## Museums & Parks: Reseller API API endpoints (v1) API reference: https://docs.cm.com/live/museum-park-reseller/v1/api-reference Base URL: `https://globalreseller.nl/webservices` ### POST /getAvailableUsers /getAvailableUsers This functionality allows you to get all available users within the system. **Note** Best practise is to cache this information and reload the availableUsers periodically (for example: once a day). **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + environment)` ### POST /getTicketTypes /getTicketTypes This functionality allows you to get all available tickettypes of a selected user (museum). **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + environment + language + ticketDate + userId)` **Note** Please note: optional fields only needs to be included when an optional field is used. ### POST /getAvailability /getAvailability This functionality allow you to get the availability of a specified period. This depends on what availability type is set within the system for this client. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + endDate + environment + showTicketsAllocation + startDate + userId)` **Please note** There are three types of availability: - Timeslots - Date - Period ### POST /createReservation /createReservation This functionality allows you to start a ticket reservation. It's possible to reserve multiple tickets in one call / reservation. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + environment + ticketDate + ticketTime + tickets + userId)` Please note: optional fields only needs to be included when an optional field is used. ### POST /createCompleteReservation /createCompleteReservation This request bundles the functionality of createReservation and completeReservation together. It's advisable to use this end-point when your application create & completes in the same second. **Contactinfo required** For some clients it is mandatory to add contact info to this request. Below is the list of clients where this information is required. | Museum name: | Requested as of: | |---|---| | Maddame Taussade Amsterdam | 01-01-2023 | | Amstedam Dungeon | 01-01-2023 | **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + customerEmailAddress + customerFirstName + customerSurname + environment + ticketDate + ticketTime + tickets + userId)` Please note: optional fields only needs to be included when an optional field is used. ### POST /completeReservation /completeReservation With this functionality you will be able to complete a reservation. **Please note:** By calling this function you have confirmed the purchase of the tickets. The tickets will be billed by the relevant user (museum) in the production environment. Tickets from the TEST environment are not valid at the museum. **Contactinfo required** For some clients it is mandatory to add contact info to this request. Below is the list of clients where this information is required. | Museum name: | Required as of: | |---|---| | Van Gogh Museum | 01-01-2019 | | Madame Tussaud Amsterdam | 01-01-2023 | | Amsterdam Dungeon | 01-01-2023 | **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + customerEmailAddress + customerFirstName + customerSurname + environment + reservationId + userId)` Please note: optional fields only needs to be included when an optional field is used. ### POST /cancelReservation /cancelReservation With this function you can cancel a reservation. This is only possible with a valid reservationId. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + environment + reservationId + userId)` ### POST /cancelCompleteReservation /cancelCompleteReservation With this function you can cancel a complete reservation. This is only possible with a valid reservationId and if the user allows to cancel a complete reservation. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + environment + reservationId + userId)` ### POST /addContact /addContact This functionality is used to add contact information to a reservation. Please add as many customer information as possible for support and aftersale purposes for the users (museums). **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + customerAddressCity + customerAddressNumber + customerAddressPostalCode + customerAddressStreet + customerCountry + customerEmailAddress + customerFirstName + customerMiddleName + customerPhoneNumber + customerSurname + environment + reservationId + userId)` ### POST /checkContact /checkContact This functionality is used to check if "addContact" was successful. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + reservationId)` --- ## Museums & Parks: Scan API API endpoints (v1) API reference: https://docs.cm.com/live/museum-park-scan/v1/api-reference Base URL: `https://globalticket.com/webservices/scanapi` ### POST /getBarcodeStatus /getBarcodeStatus This function allows you to get the status of a barcode (valid / invalid) and information about the ticket(s). **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + barcodeNumber)` ### POST /setBarcodeStatus /setBarcodeStatus This function allows you to set the barcode (ticket) status to “checked in”. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + barcodeNumber)` ### POST /getAvailability /getAvailability With this functionality you can retrieve the availability of a specified article (ticket type). > **Note:** This function only returns tickettypes that have been made available for sale through API. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + ticketTypeId + ticketDate*)` ### POST /createReservation /createReservation With this functionality you can create a reservation. Create a reservation for a single ticket type, or for multiple ticket types by sending the `tickets` object. > **Note:** Reservations are by default valid for 15 minutes. Please use “reservationValidUntil” to prevent errors at the completeReservation method. **HMACKey:** - Single ticket type: not documented - Multiple ticket types: `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + ticketDate + tickets)` **HMAC calculation of the `tickets` array** Sort the entries by ticketTypeId ascending and the keys within each entry alphabetically, then concatenate the values. Example (PHP): ```php $tickets = [ '321' => [ 'ticketNumber' => 2, 'ticketTime' => '10:00' ], '123' => [ 'ticketTime' => '12:00', 'ticketNumber' => 3 ], ]; // sorted and concatenated: $result = '123312:00321210:00'; ``` ### POST /updateReservation /updateReservation With this functionality you can update a reservation. Update a reservation for a single ticket type, or for multiple ticket types by sending the `tickets` object. **HMACKey:** - Single ticket type: `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + reservationId + ticketTypeId + ticketNumber + ticketDate + ticketTime)` - Multiple ticket types: `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + reservationId + ticketDate + tickets)` **HMAC calculation of the `tickets` array** Sort the entries by ticketTypeId ascending and the keys within each entry alphabetically, then concatenate the values. Example (PHP): ```php $tickets = [ '321' => [ 'ticketNumber' => 2, 'ticketTime' => '10:00' ], '123' => [ 'ticketTime' => '12:00', 'ticketNumber' => 3 ], ]; // sorted and concatenated: $result = '123312:00321210:00'; ``` ### POST /completeReservation /completeReservation With this functionality you can complete an earlier made reservation. The output contains the barcodes of the reservation. **HMACKey:** `Base64 encode - SHA256(apiKey + reservationId + scanTicket*)` ### POST /cancelReservation /cancelReservation With this functionality you can cancel an earlier created reservation. It provides an overview of the Exact Online CRM integration process. --- ## **Overview** The Exact Online CRM integration connects a customer's Exact Online administration with the Marketplace platform. Changes to customers (**Accounts**) and **Sales orders** in Exact Online are pushed to the Marketplace through Exact Online webhooks and forwarded to CDP. This guide is divided into two sections: 1. **Customer Setup**: What the customer needs to do in Exact Online and provide to enable the integration. 2. **Delivery Setup**: What our team configures on the Marketplace platform based on the customer's input. --- ## **How it works** - **Authentication**: OAuth 2.0 with the customer's **own** Exact Online app (Client ID and Client Secret). The customer authorizes the connection once. - **Token refresh**: Exact Online access tokens are valid for 10 minutes, and every refresh token can be used **only once**. The Marketplace refreshes the token automatically (about every 10 minutes) and stores the new refresh token each time. No action is needed from the customer. - **Data flow**: After authorization, the Marketplace automatically registers Exact Online webhooks for `Accounts` and `SalesOrders`. When a record is created or changed, Exact Online notifies the Marketplace, which reads the full record from the Exact Online API and forwards it to CDP. - **Access**: Read-only. The integration does not create, change or delete data in Exact Online. \:::warning Single-use refresh tokens The Marketplace must be the only system that refreshes the Exact Online token for a connection. If another tool (for example a script, Postman or another platform) uses the same refresh token, the token chain breaks and the customer has to authorize again. \::: --- ## **Integration Setup Process** 1. [**Customer Setup for Exact Online**](https://docs.cm.com/marketplace/crm-integrations/exact-online-crm/customer-setup-for-exact-online.md): The customer creates a dedicated read-only user, registers an internal app in Exact Online, shares the Client ID, Client Secret and Division, and authorizes the connection. 2. [**Delivery Setup for Exact Online**](https://docs.cm.com/marketplace/crm-integrations/exact-online-crm/delivery-setup-for-exact-online.md): Our team configures the integration on the Marketplace platform using the customer's details and verifies that data is flowing. --- ## HubSpot CRM Source: https://docs.cm.com/marketplace/crm-integrations/hubspot-crm.md It provides an overview of the HubSpot CRM integration process and how it enables seamless data synchronization between HubSpot and the Marketplace platform. --- ## **Overview** The HubSpot CRM integration allows you to connect your HubSpot account with the Marketplace platform to synchronize customer data. It serves as a bridge between the Paylogic ticketing system and a Customer Data Platform (CDP), ensuring that ticket sales and personalization data are efficiently synchronized and made available for further processing and analysis. ### Process Overview The synchronization process runs on the configured schedule and triggers the Paylogic Adapter to fetch and process both order sales and ticket personalization data. The adapter employs sophisticated filtering mechanisms to ensure only new or updated data is processed, reducing unnecessary data transfer. For order sales, the system processes each event individually, while for ticket personalization, it handles multiple events in a single API call. After collecting and processing the data, the system prepares it for transmission to the CDP. This preparation includes batching the data into manageable groups of 50 objects each, ensuring efficient data transfer and processing. Throughout the process, the system maintains detailed job history records, allowing for resilient operation and the ability to resume from the last known good state in case of interruptions or failures. This comprehensive approach ensures that the CDP always has access to the most up-to-date and relevant ticket sales and customer personalization data, enabling enhanced customer insights and more effective event management strategies. To create connected app, follow the instructions: 1. Log in to your Salesforce Developer Account. 2. Navigate to the App Manager. 3. Click on the "New Connected App" button. 4. Fill in the basic information: - Connected App Name: Enter a suitable name for your connected app. - API Name: Provide a unique API name for your connected app. - Contact Email: Enter your contact email address. 5. Enable OAuth Settings: - Check the "Enable OAuth Settings" box. 6. Configure the Callback URL: - In the "Callback URL" field, enter the URL where Salesforce will redirect the user after authentication. Example: `https://www.yourapp.com/callback-url` 7. Add OAuth Scopes: - In the "Selected OAuth Scopes" section, add the required scopes for your application (e.g., `openid`, `profile`, `email`). 8. Save the connected app. 9. Obtain the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret: - After saving, note down the "Consumer Key" and "Consumer Secret" values from the connected app detail page. ## **Setup OAuth/App flow:** 1. Implement the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow in your app: - Create a login button in your app's user interface, such as a web page or mobile app screen. - When the user clicks on the "Login with Salesforce" button, redirect them to the Salesforce OAuth authorization endpoint (`https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/authorize`). - Include the following parameters in the redirect URL: - `response_type=code` (for authorization code flow) - `client_id={your_consumer_key}` - `redirect_uri={your_callback_url}` - `scope={requested_scopes}` (e.g., `openid`, `profile`, `email`) 2. Handle the callback from Salesforce: - After the user logs in with their Salesforce credentials and grants the requested permissions, Salesforce will redirect them to your specified callback URL. - In your app, implement a callback endpoint or function to receive this redirect. - Extract the `code` parameter from the callback URL. 3. Exchange the authorization code for an access token and user information: - Make a server-side request from your app to the Salesforce token endpoint (`https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token`). - Include the following parameters in the request payload: - `grant_type=authorization_code` - `client_id={your_consumer_key}` - `client_secret={your_consumer_secret}` - `redirect_uri={your_callback_url}` - `code={the_code_from_callback}` - Parse the response from Salesforce, which will include the access token, refresh token, and other details. - You can use the access token to make API calls on behalf of the user and retrieve their information. This enables you to target your existing contacts with ads on Facebook. ## Prerequisites Before setting up the integration, ensure you have the following: 1. **Facebook Business Portfolio (Business Manager)** — You must have an active Business Portfolio. If you don't have one, create it at [business.facebook.com](https://business.facebook.com). 2. **Facebook Ad Account** — An Ad Account linked to your Business Portfolio. Note down the Ad Account ID (numeric, found in Business Manager under Ad Accounts). 3. **Admin Access** — The user authorizing the connection must have admin/full control permissions on the Business Portfolio. 4. **Custom Audience Terms of Service Accepted** — Before the integration can create Custom Audiences, you must accept Facebook's Custom Audience Terms. - Visit: `>` - This is a one-time requirement per ad account. 5. **Audience Source** — Contacts can be synced from either of the following (pick one per adapter): - **AddressBook Groups** — contact groups already created in AddressBook, or - **CXP Segments** — segments built in CM's CDP/CXP platform. If you plan to use this source, you'll also need your **CXP Tenant ID** — contact the CM CDP/CXP team if you don't already have this, so it can be configured on your adapter. ## Setup Steps ### Step 1: Start Authorization 1. Navigate to the CDP Marketplace and select the **Facebook Ads** adapter. 2. Click \*\*Connect to authorize Facebook Ads \*\*to start the connection process. \[Facebook Ads adapter in the Marketplace with the Connect button] ### Step 2: Select Your Business Portfolio - Facebook will ask: **"Which business portfolio would you like to connect to CDP Ads Integration?"** - Select your Business Portfolio from the list. - Click **Continue**. \[Facebook dialog for selecting a business portfolio] ### Step 3: Grant Ad Account Access - Facebook will ask you to choose which **Ad Accounts** the integration can access. - Select the ad account(s) you want to use for Custom Audiences. - Click **Continue**. \[Facebook dialog for choosing which ad accounts the integration can access] **NOTE: Please select only the Ads account that you have provided to the delivery team. Do not choose any other account.** ### Step 4: Review and Confirm Permissions - Review the requested permissions (Ad accounts and `ads_management` permission). - Click **Save** to confirm. \[Facebook dialog reviewing the requested permissions] ### Step 5: Connection Complete - You will see a confirmation: **"\[Your Business] has been connected to CDP Ads Integration"**. - Click **Got it** — you will be redirected back to the Marketplace. \[Facebook confirmation that the business has been connected] - The integration will generate a System User Access Token that does not expire. You do not need to re-authorize unless you revoke access. ### Step 6: Configure the Adapter After authorization, provide the following configuration: | Field | Description | Example | | - | - | - | | Ad Account ID (Required) | Your Facebook Ad Account ID (numeric) | 123456789 | | Sync Schedule (Required) | Cron expression for automatic sync | You can inform the delivery team about when you would like to sync the data, specifying the schedule for example, daily at a specific time, on Sundays, or on the 1st of every month. | | AddressBook Groups | Select the contact groups to sync | Select from the dropdown | **Facebook Ad Account**: An Ad Account linked to the Business Portfolio you intend to authorize. To find your Ad Account ID: - Go to [Facebook Ads Manager](https://adsmanager.facebook.com) - Click the **Account dropdown** in the top-left corner - Your Ad Account ID is the numeric value displayed below the account name (e.g., `123456789`) - Ensure this ad account is linked to the Business Portfolio you will grant access to during authorization \[Ad Account ID below the account name in Facebook Ads Manager] **Manage Groups to Sync** You can click on the **Manage Groups** button, which will redirect you to a page where you can select the groups you want to sync with Facebook Ads. \[Manage Groups button in the Facebook Ads adapter configuration] You can select multiple groups that you want to sync and can click on **save gr

<style>
    /* =========================================================
       hl- — highlight block
       ========================================================= */
    .hl-block {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        border-radius: 10px;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: relative;
    }

    /* Halo glow overlay */
    .hl-block--halo::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 0;
        background: url('https://www.cm.com/cdn/web/en/team/messaging/glow-bg.png') center / cover no-repeat;
        mix-blend-mode: screen;
        opacity: 0.7;
        pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hl-block--halo > * {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Columns
       ========================================================= */
    .hl-container { container-type: inline-size; }
    .hl-half { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; }

    /* --- Stacked default: ≤992px --- */
    .hl-half--text  { order: -1; padding: 32px 40px 24px 40px; }
    .hl-half--media { padding: 0 40px 32px 40px; }
    .hl-half--cards { padding: 0 40px 32px 40px; }

    /* --- Tablet: ≤768px --- */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .hl-half--text  { padding: 28px 32px 20px 32px; }
        .hl-half--media { padding: 0 32px 24px 32px; }
        .hl-half--cards { padding: 0 32px 28px 32px; }
    }

    /* Body bottom margin (must come before desktop @media so p:last-child inside it wins) */
    .hl-half--text p:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 28px; }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .hl-half--text p:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 22px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 991px) {
        .hl-half--text:has(.s-button--tertiary) p:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 24px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .hl-half--text:has(.s-button--tertiary) p:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 18px; }
    }

    /* --- Desktop row layout (≥992px) --- */
    @media (min-width: 992px) {
        .hl-block {
            flex-direction: row;
            align-items: stretch;
        }
        .hl-half { width: 50%; }

        /* Default: text visually on RIGHT (text is first in DOM, swapped via order) */
        .hl-block:not(.hl-block--text-left) .hl-half--text   { order: 2; padding: 40px 80px 40px 40px; }
        .hl-block:not(.hl-block--text-left) .hl-half--media,
        .hl-block:not(.hl-block--text-left) .hl-half--cards  { order: 1; padding: 40px 40px 40px 80px; }

        /* Text-left variant */
        .hl-block--text-left .hl-half--text  { order: 1; padding: 40px 40px 40px 80px; }
        .hl-block--text-left .hl-half--media,
        .hl-block--text-left .hl-half--cards { order: 2; padding: 40px 80px 40px 40px; }

        /* Text column: center vertically when other column is taller */
        .hl-half--text { align-self: center; }
        /* Remove body margin when no button follows (desktop only) */
        .hl-half--text p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

        /* Media column: center image vertically + horizontally */
        .hl-half--media {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        /* Cards column: center stack vertically */
        .hl-half--cards {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Media image
       ========================================================= */
    .hl-media-img {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Typography — theme overrides
       ========================================================= */

    /* Eyebrow: white on highlight, cyan gradient on halo */

<script>
    /**
     * Determine the mobile operating system.
     * This function returns one of 'iOS', 'Android', 'Windows Phone', or 'unknown'.
     *
     * @returns {String}
     */
    function getMobileOperatingSystem() {
        var userAgent = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;

        // Windows Phone must come first because its UA also contains "Android"
        if (/windows phone/i.test(userAgent)) return "WindowsPhone";
        if (/android/i.test(userAgent)) return "Android";
        // iOS detection from: http://stackoverflow.com/a/9039885/177710
        if (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(userAgent) && !window.MSStream) return "iOS";

        return "unknown";
    }

    /**
     * Determine the operating system.
     * This function returns one of 'Windows', 'MacOS', 'UNIX', 'Linux' or 'unknown'.
     *
     * @returns {String}
     */
    function getOperatingSystem() {
        if (navigator.appVersion.indexOf("Win") != -1) return "Windows";
        if (navigator.appVersion.indexOf("Mac") != -1) return "MacOS";
        if (navigator.appVersion.indexOf("X11") != -1) return "UNIX";
        if (navigator.appVersion.indexOf("Linux") != -1) return "Linux";

        return "unknown";
    }

    /**
     * set conversation variables
     *
     * @param {object} cmwcInstance
     */
    function setConversationContext(cmwcInstance) {

        if(!window.conversationContext)
        {
            window.conversationContext = {
                geoIP                : 'US',
                country              : '',
                websiteLanguage      : 'en',
                mobileOperatingSystem: getMobileOperatingSystem(),
                operatingSystem      : getOperatingSystem(),
                url                  : window.location.href,

                            };
        }

        // Add Tracedock to agent context asynchronously.
        // It will be present in future contexts if not in time for the first call.
        window.cookieStore.get("anonymous_id").then(cookie => {
            if (cookie && cookie.value) {
                window.conversationContext.anonymous_id = cookie.value;
                console.log("Tracedock id added to context");
            }
        }).catch(e => {
            console.error("Error fetching tracedock id", e);
        });

        const storedData = sessionStorage.getItem('formData');
        const formData = (storedData) ? JSON.parse(storedData) : {};

        const context = Object.assign({}, window.conversationContext, formData);

        for (const i in context) {
            if (typeof context[i] === 'undefined' || context[i] === '') {
                delete context[i];
            }
        }

        console.log("Conversation context set: ", context);
        cmwcInstance.addContext(context);

    }
</script>

<script>
    let CURRENT_LANGUAGE = "";

    function waitForElm(selector) {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
                return resolve(document.querySelector(selector));
            }

            const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
                if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
                    observer.disconnect();
                    resolve(document.querySelector(selector));
                }
            });

            observer.observe(document.body, {
                childList: true,
                subtree: true
            });
        });
    }

    function addCustomStyling() {
        waitForElm('[configkey="3634145b-e3e3-4118-b645-3c3d7a222298"]').then((elm) => {
            const style = document.createElement('style');

            style.textContent = `
                .wc-c-root {
                    --wc-c-root-z-index: 69 !important;
                    max-height: calc(100svh - 80px);
                }
                `;
            elm.shadowRoot.appendChild(style);
        });
    }

    function hideNotification() {
        waitForElm('[instancekey]').then((elm) => {
            const style = document.createElement('style');
            style.textContent = `
                div[aria-live="assertive"][role="log"] {
                    display: none !important;
                }
            `;
            elm.shadowRoot.appendChild(style);
        });
    }

</script>
